reason: I only shop when there's an occasion, and early November isn't one for me. Ramadan is months away and I don't have a wedding coming up, so I'd put my name on the early-access list and come back in the new year instead of buying now.
objection: I'm not buying anything until I have a reason to. And when I do, I need to know they really carry lengths that work for my height and not just one standard size. A fitting room check sounds nice, but only if the right length is actually on the rack.
would_change_my_mind: A wedding or family event coming up in November. Then the fit check in the fitting room and the free 14-day exchange would get me in to try on a thobe.
